notes: Piece count: 214 = 209 built pieces (b1-b209) + 5 minifig accessories (b210-b214: small sword, ring, trans-clear gem, fish, gladius).

The graph has 7 connected groups. I kept this because the booklet really builds separate things. (1) Gollum's hideout b1-b29 is a standalone model built on pages 4-9 and never touches the spider. (2) Shelob b30-b209 is one connected model: the body, 8 legs, fangs and abdomen are joined, the abdomen to the body by the ball-loop pin b56 into the pin hole of b164. (3-7) The five accessories b210-b214 are only held in minifig hands (Frodo, Sam, Gollum).

The minifig bodies (heads, torsos, legs, hair, cloaks) are not in the supplied parts list, so there is nothing in the graph for the accessories to attach to. The booklet shows no brick connection for them, so I did not invent one and left them unattached with rests_on [].

rests_on follows the build direction shown in the booklet: the piece added later lists the earlier piece it clutches. This includes the flipped sub-assemblies (2x4 plate b11 with b14/b15/b16, wedge b148 with b149, and the 4600 plate b158).

Many contact details are hard to read from the small illustrations and are my best interpretation. These include which piece rests on which for the crossed swivel plates, the layering of the abdomen wedges, the tan plates and the brackets, and the cheese slopes on the hideout.

Each of the 8 legs is built the same way: 3710 base, two 44301a black hinge plates, a tile, three 44302a plates, a slope, a hinge cylinder and a claw. The leg root plate (44302a) sits on one of the 8 swivel plates (73983) of the body.
Catalogue ports for some inverted slopes and wedges show no studs. I still recorded the resting contacts seen in the pictures.

Part elements in the booklet's own inventory differ slightly from the supplied parts list (for example 4271950 vs 6146225 for the 1x2x1 panel). I matched them by shape and colour, and quantities match the supplied list.
